# Minting the voucher fails: the chat is still minting, and mints again when the client starts
# again, keeping the code it then mints in voucher-g.txt.

fail-next bob Mint
join bob g
run
state bob g
----
not joined, minting

show bob g
----
— minting a voucher
— mint a voucher failed: injected

restart bob
run
state bob g
----
not joined, awaiting a reply

voucher-file bob g
----
the code

create alice g
run
invite alice g bob
run
members bob g
----
alice

send bob g hello
run
show alice g
----
— a new group: adding a member's voucher code adds them
— reading the voucher
— added ~bob: they now read everything said in this group
bob: hello
